dimensionsMm.raw: Dimensions (H x W x D): 465 x 225 x 430 mm
dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: NZXT labels the figures (H x W x D), so heightMm is quoted rather than inferred. Depth is recorded as lengthMm and width as thicknessMm, matching the case convention already used for case.lian-li-a3-matx-black and cooler.noctua-nh-d15-g2.

clearanceLimits.raw: Dimensions (H x W x D): 465 x 225 x 430 mm | GPU Length: Up to 410 mm | CPU Cooler Height: Up to 170 mm | PSU Length: Up to 200 mm | Motherboard Support: E-ATX (Up to 277 mm), ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX

notes: Published clearance facts that the cat6 contract has no field for, kept verbatim rather than dropped, from source.cat6.nzxt.h5-flow.product. Motherboard support: the product also accepts E-ATX (up to 277 mm) and Mini-ITX; compat2's CaseCompatSpec models only ATX and Micro-ATX, so both are dropped from supportedFormFactors and the omission is recorded here rather than silently lost. All three clearance limits ('Up to ...') are printed as plain ceilings with no configuration-dependent branch, so each is recorded as a single unconditional ClearanceLimit.
